Commentary.Commentary: 278 to chase then. A couple of days ago, Pakistan struggled to get to 200 in a chase of 267. But that was Abu Dhabi. This is Dubai. Here, the pitch tends to get better under lights. Plus, Australia are without Jhye Richardson and Pat Cummins. Will that make any difference? Join us back in a while to find out!

Ohh... Pakistan. Played like Pakistan. The first half was THAT Pakistan. The second half was THIS Pakistan. That Pakistan saw its bowlers choke Australia in Powerplay 1, then get the wickets, pushing them against the wall. THIS Pakistan created a tunnel themselves to allow their cornered opposition to escape. No one but the hosts themselves are to be blamed for this. 2 wickets apiece for Hasnain, Imad and Yasir but those figures could have been much better. 86 came in the last 10 overs.

Glenn Maxwell is such a player that you can never predict what you can get with him. So the earlier you dismiss him, the better. Because the longer he stays, the show gets bigger. He offered three chances - one was put down, one the fielder did not quite track the ball and the third one, he was cleaned up but Usman overstepped. He ended up scoring 98, which is more than one-third of Australia's total. Carey gave him good support in that 134-run stand for the sixth wicket.

Cannot say Australia batted out of their skins but have to say they hung in out there. They played the old 60s and 70s mode of cricket or probably even the 80s and 90s where the theme was to keep wickets in hand and then go hard at the death. Aaron Finch and Usman Khawaja got off to a slow start and then almost paid the price for it as from 56/0, they slipped to 101/4. Khawaja's dismissal in the 29th over seemed to indicate towards a sluggish finish but then came the tough luck for Pakistan.

Remarkable. Australia's fightback. Unbelievable. Pakistan's effort. Rotten. Pakistan's luck. That is the best one can sum up this innings. Like always, the home side has the team on the mat, only to take it easy and then get throttled itself. What could have been a target of 200 at best, is now shot up close to 280.

OUT! Caught. A wicket on the final ball of the innings. Full and outside off, Carey looks to back away and clear mid off but unfortunately for him, he cannot clear the inner ring. Simple catch for Haris Sohail and the young Hasnain has done tremendously here. Just 5 runs from his final over and AUSTRALIA END ON 277/7.
Outside off, pushed towards Yasir Shah at cover for another single.
Wide outside off, drilled through the covers for one.
Full and outside off, driven towards long off for a run.
Nathan Coulter-Nile walks in at number 8, replacing Maxwell.

OUT! Maxwell misses his century by 2 runs! Oh dear... that is sad for him but on the other hand, he deserves plenty of praise. Not many players in the world would let go of that prize of a century but Maxi has played for the team here. He drills this through the covers, but straight to the fielder. He charges back for the suicidal second and the throw from Masood is right at the stumps and Rizwan does the rest. The appeal is referred upstairs and replays show that Maxi is short by a few inches. The Australian supporters are shocked. So is Justin Langer. Now, he gets up and gives a standing ovation to the Big Show for a wonderful knock of 98 from 82 balls and also for not playing for that century. Of course, add those no balls and it becomes a different issue but right now, a look at the scorecard would suffice.
Is Maxwell run out on 98? This could be a heartbreak for him. Referred upstairs...
Yorker outside off, squeezed through point for a single.
Mohammad Hasnain to bowl the final over. How much can Australia finish with? 280? 285?

FOUR! Boundary to end this 13-run over. What a shot! Batting text book won't help me to describe this shot, but worth a try. A good length delivery on off, Maxwell gets across initially for the paddle towards fine leg. But then he realizes that the ball is outside off. So what does he do? No problem. Just ramps it over short third man! Stressing again - it is not a reverse, it is a literal ramp over that fielder. That is typical Maxi for you - innovative and exciting.
Full on off. A hard hit toward mid on by Carey allows him a single.
Usman drifts this one down to leg side, Carey flicks it to the square leg and grabs a double.
Full length delivery on off, Maxwell slices it towards the third man region for a single.
FOUR! A back of length outside leg, Maxwell was already waiting for it. He pulls it away to fine leg for a boundary. You can't  bowl this line to Maxwell.

BALL HITS THE STUMPS, BATSMAN IS OUT OF THE CREASE BUT IT IS NOT OUT! Why? Because the bails did not fall! Nothing going right for Pakistan since the wicket of Khawaja. Full and outside off, reversing in, Carey digs it out back to the bowler. Usman looks to stop but the ball ricochets off his hands. Now, Carey calls for the run. But hello, what is he doing? For the ball is going right at the stumps! It hits the timber at the other end and Alex puts in a fruitless dive but the bails stay as they are! Now Carey gets up and raises his bat to acknowledge his fifty! Could have been run out on 49, should have been run out on 49 but well, these are those days...
That ball has taken the inside edge onto the pads. They pick up a single.
Short ball again, pulled towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
A short ball, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Outrageous stuff this from Maxwell. A very low full toss on leg, Maxwell gets down on one knee and paddles it over the keeper's head for a boundary.
Shorter on middle and off, Carey pulls it away for a single.
Good ball this. Maxwell moves away from the leg stump. Yorker on the leg side. Cramps Maxwell for room. He does well to get his bat down and run away for a single.
A yorker to end the innings. Outside off, Maxwell slices it towards the third man region for a single.
A short delivery on off, Carey plays it to mid off for a single.
Very good delivery by Usman. Full outside off, Carey looks to slice it but fails to connect.
A fuller length on leg and middle, Maxwell digs it towards the mid-wicket region for a single.
Yes he will. Maxwell makes a good use of this Free Hit. Full on leg, Maxwell tonks it above mid-wicket for a one bounce four.

NO BALL! Oh dear! What have you done here Usman? Maxwell is one lucky man. Full length delivery on off, Maxwell looks to play it across the line over long on. He chops it onto the stumps and starts walking back. Pakistan players celebrate but their celebration is cut short as the replays show  Usman Khan had overstepped his line. Maxwell comes back. No ball signalled and Free Hit to follow. Will Maxwell make Shinwari pay for it?
A back of a length on off, Carey just whacks a pull to mid-wicket for a single.
Usman Khan back on.
Fuller on middle, Carey strokes it to long on and keeps the strike.

Good ball this. Good length delivery on middle, Junaid produces good amout of reverse swing on this one. Carey makes room and looks to play it on the off side but misses. The ball just continues swinging. Rizwan dives to his right but cannot stop it. Fine leg mops it up nut two runs taken. Byes signalled. 100 partnership up between the two.
Length ball outside off, Maxwell taps it down to third man for a single.
FOUR! Shorter delivery on middle, Maxwell stands tall and slashes his pull over square leg for a boundary. One trick too many this from Junaid.
WIDE! The idea was right but the execution was not. He bowls a very slow bouncer but it bounces too high. Maxwell backs out of his pull shot. Wide signalled.
Yorker on middle, Alex plays it to mid-wicket and takes a run.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. The batsmen have run through for a single.
On the pads, Maxwell glances it to the fine leg region for a run. He will keep the strike. 10 runs off the over.
Now a single, this one is full on off, Carey strokes it to point for a single.
FOUR! Another short ball from Hasnain. This it outside off, Carey once again picks it up early and whacks this through backward point for the second consecutive boundary off the over.
FOUR!Shorter delivery on middle, Carey picks the length early and pulls it over square leg for a boundary.
Another dot. Good length ball on off, Carey hits it straight to cover.
Good bowling. Very good bowling this. A very slow off cutter on a length outside off, Carey was way too early in his shot and misses it.
A good slower bouncer this. Pitching on off, Maxwell looks to pull it but gets an edge falls just short of wicket keeper Rizwan.
A slower bouncer outside off, Maxwell looks to pull it but changes his mind and lets it go.
A full toss outside off, Maxwell slices it from his back foot above mid on for a double.
A good bowl this. Back of a length on middle and leg, Carey flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
A short pitch delivery on middle and leg, Maxwell pulls it for a single.
A fuller delivery on leg, Maxwell was looking for a flick, gets the bottom part of the bat and it the ball goes to the wicket keeper Mohammad Rizwan, who dives and collects it.
Junaid Khan to bowl now.
A back of a length on middle and leg, Maxwell flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Full outside off, Maxwell makes some room but fails to make any connection with the ball.
A short delivery this time, Carey now pulls it to square leg for another single.
Slower one on middle and leg, Carey taps it to covers.
Shorter delivery outside off, Carey cuts it straight to point.
A back of a length on middle and leg, Maxwell plays it to mid off for a single.
Mohammad Hasnain is back into the attack.
Full on leg, Carey defends it with ease. He ends with figures of 10-0-57-2.
A back of a length on off, Carey cuts it to covers for a double.
Changes strike on next ball, Punched this one towards covers for a single.
SIX! Maxi gets it this time. Back of a length on off and middle, Maxwell gets on his back foot and strikes it above the bowler's head.
A quicker one outside off, Maxwell looks to cut it but fails to connect it.
A back of a length on leg, Maxwell rocks back and gives it hard swing but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Yasir Shah back on.
Follows it up with a single. He tucks this ball down the leg side for a single.
SIX! Maxwell has seen enough and has decided to go down town here. Tossed up ball on middle, Maxwell comes down the track and deposits it in the stands over long on fence for a boundary.
Tossed up on middle, Carey reverse sweeps it over backward point for a single.

Fifty up for Glenn Maxwell. His 18th in ODI cricket and he has made the most of the life he got today. On the pads, Maxwell flicks it to the leg side to get to his fifty. He has to play right till the end if Australia wan to get past 250.
Short again outside off, Alex punches it to the off side for a run.
Shorter outside off, Maxwell cuts it to point for a single.
Wide! Sprays this down the leg side. Wide signalled.
Powerplay 3 signalled. Now 5 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle till the 50th over. Imad Wasim has brought himself back on.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
On middle, Alex nudges it down to leg side for a run.
Shorter delivery on off, Maxwell pulls it away for another single.
On the pads again, this time Alex is able to flicks it on the leg side for a single.
Good bowling this. Carey moves away from the leg stump, Junaid sees it and bowls it on his pads. Carey just ends up blocking it.
Full length delivery on middle and leg, Maxwell milks it to long on and gets a single.
Another lucky escape in this over for Hasnain. Full toss outside off, Carey swings his bat at it but gets nowhere close to it. 7 runs off the over.
Shorter delivery on off, Alex pulls it away wide of deep square leg and gets a brace.
Length ball outside off, Maxwell looks to flat bat it to point but gets an inside edge and the ball goes towards backward square leg for a single. Lucky that it does not take his stumps on his way.
Length ball outside off, Alex plays it wide of point and takes a single.
Full length delivery on off, Carey drives it beautifully through covers but the sweeper cover cleans it up. Couple taken.
Full toss on middle, Maxwell plays it to long on and takes a single. Hasnain is a lucky boy to escape a beating on that one.

Great over. Only one off it. Hint of reverse swing on the last ball. It is full on leg, Carey looks to flick it but misses. Junaid asks the question but the umpire turns it down. Hawk Eye later on shows that it would have been umpires call had Pakistan taken it up stairs.
Finally a run in this over. Shorter on off, Maxi pulls it away to deep square leg for a single.
Excellent change of pace this. Slower bouncer outside off, Maxwell thinks about going after it but does not. It has been signaled one for the over. Brilliant over this so far. No runs off it yet.
Make it three dots in a row. Good length ball on the stumps, Maxwell taps it back to the bowler.
Shorter delivery, Maxwell pulls it to mid-wicket. Dot ball.

Almost chops it on. Length ball outside off, Maxwell looks to cut it but it is too close to the off stump. Luckily for him the ball hits the inside edge and bounces on the crease and does not go on to hit the stump. Australia cannot afford to lose Maxwell at this stage.
Junaid Khan back into the attack.
Dot ball to finish the over. Hasnain bowls a yorker on off, Carey does well to get his bat down and play it to point.
On the pads this time, Carey flicks it wide of deep mid-wicket and gets a couple.
Once again it is on a length outside off, Maxwell runs it down to third man and rotates the strike.
This time he is able to go past the point fielder. Good length ball outside off, Alex cuts it wide of point and takes a single as the man mops it up from third man.
Good fielding. Length ball outside off, Carey taps it down to backward point. The fielder at point though runs in from right and saves runs with a dive. Dot ball.
Full length ball on off, Carey strokes it straight to point.
Mohammad Hasnain back into the attack.
Good length ball on middle, Carey pushes it wide of mid on and keeps the strike with a single.
On middle and leg, Alex cannot clear the fielder with his flick and finds mid-wicket.
Back of a length ball on off, Maxwell hits it wide of mid off and gets a single.
Length ball on the pads, Carey flicks it to square leg and runs through for a single.
Full on off, Carey hits it straight to mid off.
Good length ball on off, Maxwell strokes it to cover and takes a single.
A nice tossed up delivery outside off. Carey looks to drive it but fails to get a connection.
Full on middle and leg, Carey keeps it away.
Maxwell rotates strike now. Fuller on leg, Maxi drives it to mid on for a single.
FOUR! Top shot by Maxwell. A short delivery in middle and leg, Maxwell rocks back and pulls it uppishly towards the vacant mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Full on leg and middle, Carey sweeps it towards the square leg region for a single.
A back of a length on off, Maxwell just taps from his back foot towards the point region and runs for a single.

Good length ball outside off, Maxwell slaps it through covers. Abid Ali there runs to his right but misfields which allows the batsmen to steal one more run. 3 runs taken overall. The fielding has been very poor from Pakistan.
Length ball on the pads, Alex tucks it behind square for a single.

Shorter delivery on middle, Carey pulls it just wide of mid-wicket and looks for a single. He comes out of his crease but Maxwell sends him back. The fielder throws it at the keeper's end but misses. Carey would have been in even if he had hit it.
3rd dot in a row. This is full on off, Carey taps it to mid off.
Full again just outside off, Alex plays it to point and shouts a loud no to his partner.
Full length delivery on off, Carey defends it off his front foot.
A flat delivery on off, Maxwell keeps it away. Fifth consecutive dot ball to end the over.
Full on middle, Maxwell blocks it.
Full on leg, defends with ease.
A quicker one this time. Back of a length on middle and leg. Maxwell defends it.
A back of a length on off, Maxwell  defends it from his back foot.

FOUR! Maxwell clearly riding his luck. Tossed up delivery on middle, Maxwell lofts it over mid on. Junaid Khan in the deep comes running in for the catch but does not get there and the ball goes away to the boundary.

Drinks - Pakistan just about in front at this stage of the game. Half the side is back in the hut for Australia but Glenn Maxwell is out there in the middle. He holds the key here now and the onus will be on him to guide his side to a big total. Alex Carey is with him and this is a good opportunity for him to play till the end and score some runs. Pakistan, meanwhile, will be looking to break this budding partnership and restrict Australia under 220.
On the pads, Maxwell glances it to mid-wicket and gets a run. He will keep the strike.
Good length ball on off,  Maxwell calmly blocks it to mid off. Sensible batting this from Maxwell not going after every ball here. He is waiting for the bad deliveries.
Single after 3 dots. Full and on the pads, Carey strokes it wide of mid on and takes a quick single.
Three dots in a row. On a length around off, Carey taps it to mid off.
Good length delivery on off, Carey taps it to the fielder at point.
First ball of his new spell and he bowls it right on the money. It is full on off, Carey blocks it off his front foot.
Usman Khan back into the attack.
A flatter delivery on off, Maxi drives this to mid off.
A tossed up delivery on off, Maxwell defends it.
Full on off, defended with ease by Maxi.
Another sweep by Carey at same region but just a single this time.
A sweep this time, full on leg, Carey sweeps it to square leg where Junaid Khan fumbles it which allows a double.

FOUR! A reverse sweep by Carey this time. A tossed up delivery on off, Carey  with a comfortable stride reverse sweeps it through the gap between point and covers for a boundary. That brings 150 for Australia.
End of a very good over from Sohail. Just 3 runs off it. The last ball is on the pads, Carey glances it to square leg and keeps the strike.
Tossed up on middle, Carey strokes it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Shorter on off, Maxwe;ll flat bats it to sweeper cover for a single.
On middle this time, Maxwell tucks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Floated on off, Glenn pushes it to the fielder at cover.
Flighted on middle and leg, Carey sweeps it to square leg for a single.
A flighted delivery on leg, Carey steps out of his crease and drives it to mid on.
A flat delivery on middle and leg, defended with ease.
A good flighted delivery on off, Maxwell brings a big stride forward and makes it a full toss and drives it to long off for a single.
Full on leg, Carey flicks it to square leg for a boundary
A tossed up delivery on leg, Carey just keeps it away.
The next batsman in is Alex Carey.

OUT! Yasir gets the big fish. Khawaja who was looking good has to walk back and this is not what Australia wanted. It is a flighted delivery on middle and off, Khawaja looks to sweep it across the line. He has done that nicely throught the innings but it is always a risky shot. He misses his sweep this time and gets hit on the pad. Yasir goes up in appeal and feels he has got his man. The umpire takes his time but the raises his finger. Khawaja has a chat with his partner regarding the referal they decide not to take it. Good decision as Hawk Eye later on show he was plumb in front.
FOUR! Poor ball to end the over. It is full outside leg, Maxwell sweeps it fine to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Short on off, Maxwell punches it to the fielder at mid off.
This time tucks it wide of the same fielder. Single taken.
On middle and leg this time, Khawaja tucks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Slightly shorter outside off, Khawaja guides it to the fielder at short third man. Maxwell looks for a single but Khawaja sends him back.
Starts with a flighted ball on the pads, Maxwell tucks it to square leg and takes an easy single.
Haris Sohail is into the attack now.
Full on off, Khawaja defends it with ease.

FOUR! Another reverse sweep by Khawaja. A nice flighted delivery on off, Khawaja finds the gap between point and cover. Boundary signaled by the umpire. Khawaja is now proving solidity in his batting.
A back of a length on middle and leg. Maxwell was looking for a pull, but fails to get the middle of the bat as the ball hurried to him. Just a single added.
Full on leg, Maxwell defends it with ease.
A quicker one. Back of a length on off, Maxwell slices it to point.
A flighted delivery on middle and leg, Khawaja flicks it for a single.

Sensible batting this from Australia. They have got the boundary and they follow that with 4 consecutive singles. This one in full on middle and leg, Khawaja milks it to long on for a run. 8 runs off the over without any risk being taken.
Once again Wasim lands it outside off, Maxwell plays it to deep cover and gets to the other end.
Floated on middle, Khawaja flicks it to mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Shorter outside off, Maxwell flat bats it to cover for a single.
FOUR! A very loose delivery from Wasim. The fine leg is inside the circle. Wasim bowls it on the leg side, Maxwell just paddle sweeps it fine of the fielder there for a boundary.
Quicker on middle and leg, Maxwell taps it back to the bowler.
Full on leg, Khawaja defends it.
Maxwell cautiously plays this one towards the mid-wicket region for a single.

Dropped! A quicker one this time. Maxwell rocks back and tries to cut it. Gets an outside edge of the bat, a regulation catch for Mohammad Rizwan behind the stumps. He fails to catch it and this might just prove to be too costly for Pakistan.
SIX! A super shot by Maxwell. A flighted delivery, fuller in length on middle. Maxwell plants his front foot on the pitch of the ball and lofts it over the mid on boundary
A back of a length on off, Maxwell guides it to point.
A nice tossed up delivery on middle and off by Shah, Khawaja flicks it mid-wicket. Single added.
Khawaja will keep the strike. Wasim bowls it on the pads, Usman tucks it towards square leg and gets a single.
On middle and leg, Maxwell flicks it towards mid-wicket and gets a single.
Single now. Flighted outside off, Khawaja pushes it to cover and runs for a single.
Follows it up with a dot. Outside off, Usman cuts it to the fielder at point.

FOUR! Fifty for Usman Khawaja. He gets there courtesy a school boy error from Hasnain. It is a flighted ball on middle, Khawaja just nudges it to long on. Hasnain comes in from deep and lazily tries to collect the ball but misses it and it goes right between his legs for a boundary. The job is not done yet. Australia will hope that Khawaja can convert this into a big one.
Shorter on off, Maxwell drives it for a single.
Full on leg, defended with ease.
Shah changes his line in this, Full on leg. Maxwell flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
A tossed up delivery on off, Maxwell drives it straight to covers.
Full on off, Khawaja pushes it to the cover region and runs for a single.
Full on off, And Maxwell is off the mark straight away by pushing this one to mid off for a single.
The next batsman in is Glenn Maxwell.

OUT! Bowled! Two quick wickets for Pakistan. Just what the doctor ordered. It is a googly pitching on off, Stoinis does not read it and looks to play it on the off side. The ball goes right between the gates of his pad and bat and the ball goes onto hit the middle stump. Australia need someone to support Khawaja and build the innings from here now.
Floated on off, Marcus keeps the strike by tapping it to long off for a single.
On the pads, Khawaja flicks it to the on side for a run. 100 comes up for the Aussies with that single.
Stoinis is off the mark straightaway. Shorter outside off, Stoinis flat bats it to cover for a single.
Marcus Stoinis is the new man in.

OUT! Second wicket for the skipper and he has been rewarded for his good bowling. The ploy to keep a slip has worked here. Slower delivery on middle and leg, the ball spins slightly away after pitching. Handscomb looks to play it across the linbe but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball then lobs to the fielder at first slip. Haris Sohail there takes a dolly.
Another sweep, This time not a powerful one. It is flighted on middle, Khawaja hits it to fine leg for a run.

FOUR! Beautiful shot this from Khawaja. He has been playing a lot of sweep to Imad and times this one excellently. It is tossed up on off, he hits it off the middle over mid-wicket for a boundary. This should boost his confidence.
Full on leg, Khawaja flicks it to mid-wicket. Single added.
Full on off, Khawaja drives it straight to covers.
A tossed up delivery on off, Handscomb drives it mid off for a single.
A flighted delivery on middle, Khawaja applies a reverse sweep towards the third man region and a run added.
FOUR! Perfect cover drive by Khawaja. Flighted delivery on off, Khawaja leans forward and drives it through covers for a boundary. Khawaja is now looking positive, has started building his innings.
A back of a length delivery on off, Khawaja flicks it to mid-wicket.

Close this. Quick and full outside off, Khawaja looks to play it on the off side but misses. The keeper does not collect it and the ball goes to the off side after hitting the keeper's pad. They steal a bye.
On middle and leg, Usman flicks it but finds the fielder at mi-wicket.
Slightly quicker outside off, Khawaja looks to cut it but gets beaten by the pace.
Full this time on middle, Khawaja sweeps it fine of the fine leg fielder and gets a couple.
Short again this time outside off, Handscomb flat bats it to deep cover and takes a single.
Shorter on middle, Khawaja premeditates his sweep and hits it to fine leg for a run.
Back of a length delivery on off, Handscomb punches it to mid on.
Full on leg, Khawaja nudges this one on leg side and runs for a single.
Back of a length on off, PH flicks it from his back foot towards the mid-wicket for a single.
A back of a length on off, PH plays it late to point.
Shah changes his length, bowls this one on leg and middle. Khawaja flicks it square leg for a single.
A flighted delivery outside off, Khawaja lets it go.
Yasir Shah introduced into the attack.
Bowls the last ball of the over on the pads, Usman comfortably flicks it on the on side and takes a single. Keeps the strike for the start of the next over.
Good fielding.  Flighted on middle and off, Khawaja sweeps it hard but the fielder at square leg inside the circle dives to his right and saves runs. Dot ball.
Good shot this. Imad tosses it up on off, Khawaja brings out the reverse sweep and connects it towards backward point and gets a couple.
Floated on middle, Khawaja plays it to mid-wicket and looks for a single but then decides otherwise.
Shorter delivery spinning away from Handscomb. He flat bats it to cover and takes a single.
The batsman has swept that one through the leg side. They pick up a single.
Short delivery on leg, Khawaja pulls it towards the square leg region for a single.
Fuller length delivery on off, Khawaja drives it through covers for a double.
Hasnain bowls this on off, Handscomb just taps it to mid on and runs for a single.
A back of a length off, PH drives this through covers for a double.
A back of a length delivery on off, Handscomb defends it with ease.
Wide! Hasnain drifts down the leg side. Wide signaled.
A fuller length delivery on off, Khawaja drives it through covers for a single.
On middle, pushed towards mid on.
Peter Handscomb walks in at number 4, replacing Marsh.

OUT! STUMPED! Gone by a mile. When the pitch begins to spin, Australians start looking clueless and that is exactly what is happening out there. Flighted outside off, just a bit wide, Marsh comes down the track but is nowere near the pitch of the ball. Looks to drive but misses. Easy stumping for Rizwan.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.

Oops... a bit risky. SOS comes down the track but is beaten in the flight. The ball is fired down the leg side, Marsh is beaten in the flight and gets a bit of a tickle. Misses the keeper and the batsmen get a couple.

Landed outside off, Marsh pushes it back to the bowler who is lazy to bend to his left and the ball goes through. Shaun is immediately looking for the single but Khawaja is ball-watching and sends his partner back.
Full and around middle, worked towards short mid-wicket.

A fuller length delivery on off, Marsh applies a cover drive with hard hands but gets the bottom part of the bat, the ball goes to the third man for a single. Just four runs from the over. A tidy one from Hasnain.
Khawaja wrists it to mid-wicket for another single.
A short delivery on off, Marsh pulls it towards mid-wicket. Single added.
A fuller length on leg and middle, Khawaja this time get his flick towards the mid-wicket region for a single.
A back of a length on leg, Khawaja tries to flick it but fails to connect the bat. The ball hits his thigh pad.
This is what extra pace can do. On a length outside off, Khawaja has a flirt but misses.
Fuller this time, Marsh defends it.
A flighted delivery on off, Marsh plays a text book defense.
A back of a length on off, Marsh defends it.
A floated delivery on middle and leg, Marsh flicks it mid-wicket.
Full on middle, Marsh denfends it with ease.
Full on middle, Khawaja flicks it mid on for a single.
Full on off, Marsh looks to cut but gets a bottom edge which misses the stumps and goes to the keeper.
Khawaja whips this from his pads towards the mid-wicket region for a single.
A good single by Marsh. He just taps it to mid on and runs for a single.
Full outside off, Marsh fails to get any connection.
On a good length outside off, movement away from the left-hander, left alone.
Shaun Marsh walks in at number 3, replacing his skipper.

OUT! FIRST ODI WICKET FOR MOHAMMAD HASNAIN! Big moment for the youngster. Captain Finch departs. A full length delivery on off, angling in for Finch who was looking it to work it towards the leg side. The ball hits his pads, a good appeal by the bowling team and the umpire raises his finger. Finch is happy to walk off, without even bothering to discuss with his partner regarding the review. Hawk Eye shows it was hitting the leg stump.
Was that a drop? Hard to say. Fuller length on middle, Khawaja looked to sweep but missed it. Rizwan fumbled and got hit on the chest.
Full on leg, Finch drives it to mid on for single
Full on leg, Finch flicks it square leg and runs for a double.
Good batting by Khawaja, flicks this one towards the mid-wicket region for a single.
FOUR! The reverse sweep from Khawaja and it pays dividends. 50-RUN OPENING STAND IS UP. Landed outside off, Khawaja gets out the reverse sweep and gets it past a diving short third man.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Here comes the skipper. Imad Wasim to bowl the first over of spin.
FOUR. Lovely drive by Captain Finch. Full on off, Finch just drives it straight past the bowler for a boundary.
A short delivery on leg, Khawaja pulls it to the mid-wicket region for a single.
Full on middle, Khawaja drives it to mid on.
Back of a length on middle and leg, Khawaja flicks it towards the mid-wicket region for a double.

Fuller length on off, Finch punches it straight to Imad Wasim at mid off. Wasim aims to throw it to the wicket-keeper but hits the stumps. The ball deflects towards square leg which allows Finch to steal a single.
Hasnain starts with a short delivery on leg. Khawaja pulls it towards the fine leg region for a single
POWERPLAY 2 time. 4 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. Here comes Mohammad Hasnain for the first time.

SIX! That has gone all the way! Fine way to end Powerplay 1 and we have our first six of the game. A length ball, on middle, Finch comes down the track and sends this sailing over long on! 39/0 for Australia in Powerplay 1. A slow beginning but clearly they are looking to keep wickets in hand for a big finish.
Outside off, another punch, finds the fielder again.
Outside off, punched straight to cover.
Comes down the track and has a big heave but mistimes it towards mid on.
Full on middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
A back of a length around off, Finch punches to extra cover.
Well beaten! A good length delivery outside off, Khawaja fails to put the bat on the ball.
Back of a length on middle, Finch wrists it towards the fine leg region from his back foot. Single added.
An attempted bouncer on off, Finch ducks under it. The umpire signals first bouncer for the over.
Short of good length delivery on off, Khawaja guides it towards the third man region for a single.
Beaten again! Play and miss, yet again. A great delivery pitching outside off, Khawaja looks to poke it but fails to get any connection.
Back of a length on off, Khawaja defends it from the back foot.
Slower one to end the over. Finch defends this one as well. Good comeback by Junaid. After going for a boundary early in the over, the remaining 5 balls have been dots.
Full on off, Finch punches it to mid on.
Full on middle, Finch puts it away towards short mid-wicket.
Full on off, defended with ease.
Back of a length on middle, Finch flicks it to mid-wicket.

FOUR! Junaid bowls this one back of a length around middle, Finch just opens the face of the bat at last moment, tries to guide it towards the third man region but misses. Yasir Shah gives it a chase from third man but in vain.
Outside off, punched straight to mid off.
A short ball, too quick for Khawaja who is not at all expecting it and takes his eyes off the ball. Is hit on the shoulder and the ball lobs wide of the keeper to square leg.
A short ball outside off, Khawaja looks to pull but misses.
On middle, worked through square leg for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Outside off, played towards point.
Landed outside off, dabbed towards point for a quick single.
FOUR! Nice shot. Half volley outside off, Finch drives this on the up and pierces the gap at cover!
Half volley outside off, driven straight to cover.
Outside off, punched towards mid off.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and outside off, steered behind point for a single.
Finch has driven that ball straight back. The ball has crossed the ropes. The umpire signals four runs.
The batsman has defended it with ease by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Finch has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Played to the point region by Usman. The fielder goes for a direct hit but misses the stumps. One run added to the total.
Khawaja has punched that ball through the offside.
Back of a length, around middle, Finch works it the fine leg region for a single.
Back of a length on off, Khawaja defends it to the cover region.
Full on middle, Khawaja puts it away.
Beaten again! Khawaja is not looking comfortable. A length delivery on off, Usman Khawaja again tries to poke at it but fails.
Outside off, Usman feels for it but misses.

On a good length outside off, coming in, Khawaja looks to tuck it to the leg side but misses and is hit on the pads. Junaid appeals for LBW but it is turned down. Probably missing leg and was too high as well.
Landed outside off, pushed straight to point.
Full on off, Finch defends it.

Khan opened up Khawaja in this one. A back of a length delivery on off, angled in but swings away. Usman Khawaja was looking to work it towards the mid on region but gets an outside edge towards the third man region. Single added.
A good comeback. Fuller length on off, Khawaja was just fishing outside off, gets outside edge onto the ground. Falls short of the wicket-keeper.
FOUR! Beautiful drive by Khawaja. Width offered and Usman makes full use of it. Pitching outside off, he leans forward and offers a beautiful drive through covers for a boundary.
A very good delivery. Fuller length on off, drifting away. Usman tries to play it but gets beaten.
Outside off, played straight to point.
Full on off, Finch pushes it to covers, misfield by Akmal. But saved by Hasnain at mid off.
A full length delivery on off, Finch defends it.
A back of a length around leg, Finch flicks it through the mid-wicket region for a double.
Junaid pulls his length back, on off, Finch goes on the back foot and defends it.
A good length delivery on off, Finch punches it to covers.
Junaid Khan starts with a back of a length delivery on off, Finch just blocks it with ease.
Junaid Khan to bowl with the second new ball.
A jaffa to finish. On a good length outside off, Khawaja feels for it but the ball nibbles away at the last moment and beats the outside edge.
Outside off, solidly defended to the off side.
Full and outside off, driven towards cover for a dot. Or should have been a dot. But the fielder misfields and concedes a single.

FOUR! Another loosener and this time Finch makes him pay. Full and on the pads, hardly any swing, the Aussie skipper just flicks it through mid-wicket and the ball races away. First boundary of the match.
Full and around off, pushed towards cover.
Loose start. Full and down the leg side, Finch flicks this through square leg and gets a couple.

The players are out in the middle. The usual openers - Aaron Finch and Usman Khawaja - make their way out to the middle. Usman Khan to start off proceedings with the first new ball. Finch to face the first ball today. Here we go...

AUSTRALIA TEAM NEWS - The visitors are going fine as far as injury management is concerned though Jhye Richardson's fall did cause some panic. He has been sent back to Australia and so has been Pat Cummins to manage his stress and workload. Nathan Coulter-Nile and Kane Richardson come in their place.

PAKISTAN TEAM NEWS - Injuries have been the spate of this series for Pakistan. Half their squad is injured or unwell and the other half has not quite performed. Captain Malik is out due to a injured rib today while Imam-ul-Haq has been ruled out due to high fever. Two debutants come in their place - Saad Ali and Abid Ali.

TOSS - First things first. NO SHOAIB MALIK at the toss. Imad Wasim has come out. Apparently, Malik has been diagnosed with a bruised rib and is missing this game. Wasim wins his first toss as an international captain and PAKISTAN WILL CHASE.
WEATHER - No rain forecast today. Plenty of sunshine around.

There are two different viewpoints to this series. One is playing with a view to fine tune itself before the World Cup and in the span of 21 days, Australia have suddenly become a strong contender for the major tournament, with 6 successive ODI wins. On the other hand, Pakistan are choosing to play this just as a period to test their bench strength, which means they are not too worried about the outcome and are confident about their World Cup squad.

Another Friday. Another match. Who is playing? Hyderabad and Rajasthan. Oops... what am I typing? This is what a major portion of the cricketing world  would be feeling right now. With the focus and gloss  primarily on the Indian T20 League, there is hardly any notice of the fact that Pakistan and Australia are playing a 5-match ODI series in the Middle East. And with the series already gone to Australia with 2 games to play, there is hardly any scope for the interest to develop. But, where there is hope, there is happiness. Let us wish that there is something to take away from today's game. Hello and a warm welcome to the fourth ODI between Pakistan and Australia in Dubai.
